Eden Park: hi folks! eden here  starting in eng-tools today. i'm Portland-based and terrible at office plants, but excellent at buying snacks. quick Q: is there a preferred place to leave a box of assorted cookies for the team? also low-key allergic to peanuts so i'll label things. :cookie:
WelcomeBot: welcome to Redwood, Eden! :wave: You'll get the new-hire lunch invite. The snack shelf in the kitchenette is for shared treats (label required).
Ralph: welcome!! if you stash near the coffee machine after 10am, things survive longer. also bring small signs  they work wonders.
Sage: hey Eden, welcome! fun to have more snack responsibility around here. we also have a tiny "community treats" box in the lounge. please label allergies; people are good about checking.
Noel: also FYI we do a weekly "bad-puns" slack thread on Fridays  if you bring punny cookie names you win eternal glory. :trophy:
Eden Park: perfect. i'll bring a clearly labeled tin on wednesday and maybe a sign that says "do not microwave unless you can fix the world afterwards." thanks for the warm welcome! :sparkles:
